Overview

Cascavel is a city in PR with a population of 336,307. A major agribusiness center in western Paraná, known for its modern urban planning, parks, and the Itaipu Lake region. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
